correctness.rationale: Independent exhaustive reconstruction from the LCF word used Floyd–Warshall distances, all tuples with one to three interior entries, and deletion exactly when the resulting tuple belonged to the lower length-four group. It matched all five chain and boundary profiles and the endpoint counts. The ranks computed modulo 2 are the integral ranks: B3 is a directed incidence matrix, with a ground vertex added and its row deleted for columns having just one surviving face. It is totally unimodular. Every length-four degree-three chain has exactly one distance-two step, and the graph has no 4-cycle, so that step has exactly one geodesic refinement. Thus each row of B4 has exactly one signed unit. The nonzero columns have disjoint supports and generate a primitive subgroup, independently of sign. These facts verify the asserted unit nonzero Smith factors, and the independently checked chain condition gives torsion-free H3. The result is Z^2 for each of 108 ordered pairs, Z for each of 36, and zero otherwise, totaling Z^252.
residual_risks: No conclusion about the integral automorphism representation or unspecified bidegrees; these are statements about abelian groups.

claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The first fact forces B3 to be primitive, the second forces B4 to be primitive. Hence H2 and H3 are torsion-free in each endpoint block as subgroups of the corresponding torsion-free cokernels. The universal coefficient theorem identifies the prior mod-two dimension with the integral rank with no Tor correction. This is a direct corollary without any new enumeration or delicate prime-specific estimate. This does not claim the older record explicitly stated the integral result.

value.rationale: The named graph and first nonvanishing girth boundary are reasonable motivations. However, in this single bidegree every computed endpoint rank was already published and there is no remaining all-prime ambiguity after examining the immediate incidence and unique-refinement structures. The larger exact Smith replay does not add a useful separate quantitative invariant, and the frozen claim does not assert a broader structural theorem or an integral representation. A newly formulated general statement would require its own review, not repair by relabeling this table.
residual_risks: A broader no-square theorem would be a different claim; its priority and value are not settled by this review.
